profile.headline: Principal Web Application Architect | Staff Software Engineer | Design Systems & UI Platform Architecture
profile.geoLocationName: Fort Mill, South Carolina, United States
profile.summary:
I’m a Principal Web Application Architect and Staff-level Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and building scalable web platforms.

My core focus is architecture that stays close to real code — defining frontend platforms, design systems, and technical standards while remaining hands-on in Angular, TypeScript, and cross-platform application development.

I specialize in bridging UX, engineering, and product through design-system-driven UI architecture, ensuring consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability across web, mobile, and desktop applications.

Over the years, I’ve led international teams, architected enterprise point-of-sale platforms, and delivered complex applications using Angular, Electron, Cordova, and Capacitor. I’m comfortable operating at Staff/Principal level or in hybrid Director roles where technical direction, mentorship, and platform strategy are critical.

I’m most effective in environments that value thoughtful architecture, strong engineering fundamentals, and user-centered design — without losing sight of shipping production software.
